VERIFY list:
- AZ-WORKZONE-A-COUNT — written-test question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- AZ-WORKZONE-A-PASS — passing standard not printed; nothing shown to learners (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- AZ-WORKZONE-A-FORMAT — item format not printed (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-WORKZONE-A-TIME — time limit not printed (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-WORKZONE-A-EDITION — issuer current-edition confirmation pending; issuer page was bot-challenged at intake (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-WORKZONE-D-MARKERS — route marker and mile post images not read (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-WORKZONE-E-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- AZ-WORKZONE-ETWO-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: work-zone fine rules are statutory and can be amended (for example sec12-F18), and work-zone layouts and message-sign content change with each project (for example sec12-F25).
Index: exam authority in A; audience in B; knowledge facts with misconceptions, mnemonics, glossary and dynamic-fact lines in C; confusables in C2; accuracy in D; market in E and E2; definition-of-done matrix in G.
